products.name: Zoho CRM
products.description: Multi-edition sales CRM with Free, Standard, Professional, Enterprise, and Ultimate tiers; verify annual vs. monthly per-user pricing, module limits, and export formats.

verifiedDocs.summary: Offers Free (up to 3 users), Standard, Professional, Enterprise, and Ultimate editions with distinct module, automation, and AI feature gates; verify annual vs. monthly per-user billing.
Workflow rules, custom modules, blueprints, and sandbox environments scale by edition tier; confirm per-org API and custom field ceilings before migrating.
Supports CSV module exports and scheduled data backups depending on tier; confirm full-backup frequency and attachment export rules directly in Zoho CRM documentation.

checklist: Confirm annual vs. monthly per-user pricing for your target edition (Standard, Professional, Enterprise, or Ultimate).
Verify custom module, workflow rule, and daily API call limits for your team size.
Check scheduled data backup and CSV export limits before committing to a multi-year contract.

products.name: Close
products.description: Outbound-focused sales CRM with built-in calling and SMS; verify separate calling and SMS usage fees outside base seat prices.

verifiedDocs.summary: Tiered per-seat plans (Startup, Professional, Enterprise) designed for outbound sales teams; confirm annual vs. monthly per-seat rates on the official pricing page.
Built-in VoIP calling, predictive dialer, and SMS messaging incur usage-based per-minute and per-message charges separate from base seat subscriptions.
Multiple pipelines, custom activities, call recording retention, and role-based permissions vary by plan tier; verify international calling rates before rollout.

checklist: Estimate monthly outbound calling minutes and SMS volume separately from base seat pricing.
Verify whether predictive dialer and call recording retention require Professional or Enterprise tiers.
Confirm international phone number availability and per-minute telephony rates.

products.name: Freshsales
products.description: Sales CRM and CRM Suite with Growth, Pro, and Enterprise tiers, 14-day trial, and role-based governance controls.

verifiedDocs.summary: Available across Growth, Pro, and Enterprise tiers with a 14-day free trial; confirm standalone Freshsales vs. Freshsales Suite bundling on the pricing comparison page.
Includes custom roles, field-level permissions, territory management, and audit logs on higher tiers; verify which governance controls require Enterprise.
Provides sales sequences, workflow automation, and built-in phone/email channels; confirm regional telephony credits and workflow execution caps.

checklist: Compare standalone Freshsales against Freshsales Suite if you also need marketing automation.
Verify whether territory management and field-level permissions require Pro or Enterprise.
Confirm workflow automation and sales sequence limits per billing tier.

products.name: SE Ranking
products.description: Agency and in-house SEO suite with Core ($129/mo monthly; $103.20/mo annual), Growth ($279/mo monthly; $223.20/mo annual), custom Enterprise, 14-day trial, and optional Agency Pack / API add-ons.

verifiedDocs.summary: Core ($129/mo monthly; $103.20/mo annual), Growth ($279/mo monthly; $223.20/mo annual), and custom Enterprise plans with a 14-day trial.
Optional Agency Pack (white-label reporting, client seats, Lead Generator) and API access are billed separately from base plans; verify add-on eligibility per tier.
Daily rank tracking limits, site audit page caps, and historical data retention scale with subscription tier and keyword quota.

checklist: Confirm whether white-label reporting requires the optional Agency Pack add-on on your chosen plan.
Verify daily keyword rank-tracking quotas and site audit page caps for your client count.
Check API access pricing and additional manager seat costs before annual billing.

products.name: Moz Pro
products.description: Keyword research, link research, technical SEO audits, weekly rank tracking, and AI visibility tracking across tiered plans.

verifiedDocs.summary: Tiered monthly and annual subscriptions scaling by tracked campaigns, weekly keyword rankings, pages crawled per week, and user seats.
Includes Keyword Explorer, Link Explorer, technical site crawls, weekly rank tracking, and AI visibility tracking features across Pro tiers.
Additional user seats and higher monthly query allowances depend on plan tier; confirm whether weekly vs. daily rank tracking meets reporting cadence.

checklist: Verify weekly vs. daily rank-tracking cadence against your client reporting requirements.
Confirm monthly Keyword Explorer query limits and Link Explorer export caps.
Check included user seats and additional seat pricing on your target tier.

products.name: WP Engine
products.description: Managed WordPress hosting across Essential (from $28/mo billed annually), Business (isolated resources, 99.99% uptime SLA), and custom Enterprise tiers with daily automated backups and free SSL/SSH.

verifiedDocs.summary: Offers Essential (from $28/mo billed annually), Business (isolated resources, 99.99% uptime SLA), and custom Enterprise tiers; verify monthly visit, storage, and bandwidth caps.
Includes daily automated backups, free SSL certificates, SSH access, and multi-environment workflows (Dev, Stage, Prod).
Traffic overage charges apply when monthly visits exceed plan allowances; 99.99% uptime SLA is tied to Business/Enterprise tiers rather than entry Essential plans.

checklist: Confirm monthly visit, storage, and bandwidth allowances alongside overage billing rates.
Verify whether your workload requires Business-tier isolated resources and the 99.99% uptime SLA.
Check plugin compatibility policies and staging-to-production deployment workflows.

products.name: SiteGround
products.description: Managed WordPress and shared hosting plans with promotional intro rates vs. standard renewal rates; verify regular renewal schedules by prepaid term and currency.

verifiedDocs.summary: Initial promotional rates apply only to the first billing term; standard renewal rates vary by plan (StartUp, GrowBig, GoGeek), prepaid duration, and billing currency.
Includes managed WordPress updates, daily backups, free SSL, CDN integration, and staging on GrowBig/GoGeek tiers.
Web space, recommended monthly visits, and on-demand backup/staging features differ between StartUp (1 site) and GrowBig/GoGeek (unlimited sites).

checklist: Calculate 2-year and 3-year total cost using standard renewal rates rather than Year 1 promo pricing.
Confirm whether on-demand backups and WordPress staging require GrowBig or GoGeek.
